name: layaIdeMaster-cli-pipe
description: LayaAir 3 IDE Automation CLI Command Bridge (Atomic Edition)

menu.desc: 🌟 進入交互式選單介面 (推薦手動使用)。

start.desc: Launch the IDE with the correct debugging port (9222).

stop.desc: Force close the LayaAir IDE process.

list-projects.desc: List all projects in the Launcher's recent list.

autoOpen.desc: Open a project by index (e.g. 0) or by absolute path.

open-scene.desc: Open a specific scene or prefab file by its asset path.

play.desc: Start game preview for the current or specified scene ID.

inspect.desc: Inspect the Laya runtime engine state (Stage size, node count).

expand.desc: Resolve a file path to an asset ID and expand the folder in the IDE.

select.desc: Select and scroll to a specific file in the IDE Project Panel.

collapse.desc: Collapse all folders in the Project Panel.

eval.desc: Execute arbitrary JavaScript in the IDE renderer context.
